<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="inference-functions" name="Event-Driven Inference Functions Architecture"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="3880" pageHeight="2420" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=28;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Event-Driven Inference Functions Architecture" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="3800" x="40" y="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=14;fontColor=#334155;" value="Aroma Pacífico Event-Driven Inference (us-east-1 | docs/inference-functions.md / A17): four triggers, SQS buffering, Bedrock in-Region foundation model (Nova Pro), result records, failure handling (retries & DLQs), and error observation point." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="3800" x="40" y="68" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="banner_account" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=#0f172a;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=left;spacing=12;" value="AWS Workload Account: production (pdn) | Region: us-east-1 (N. Virginia, USA) | All objects stored & processed in us-east-1 (ASM-002, PD-013) | Bedrock in-Region on-demand, zero cross-Region profiles" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="42" width="2740" x="40" y="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_azure" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#334155;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;" value="Azure: Prepared, not deployed | 10.88.0.0/13 | ADR-001" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="42" width="520" x="2800" y="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_badges" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;" value="Traceability Badges: [ D10 Inference ] [ D09 Ingestion ] [ D06 Security ] [ D04 VPC ]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="42" width="500" x="3340" y="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col1_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="TRIGGERS & INGESTION PIPELINES (Section 3)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1605" width="640" x="40" y="165" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_drone_source" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Contracted Drone Operator Ground Station (Soporte VLAN 102 | 10.4x.2.10 | ASM-140)
• Flights: Confirmation, Verification, Estimation missions preloaded before flight
• Ground Station On-Device Person Screen runs on every photo/frame before upload (ASM-164)
• Uploads flight record, manifest and raw objects to S3 via private endpoints
• Reception Function (A15) validates checksums and links objects to flight record" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="600" x="60" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_drone_source" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="Reception" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="590" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_dynamo_missions" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Amazon DynamoDB: missions Table & DynamoDB Streams (ASM-149)
• Reception function writes record_persisted in a single atomic transaction
• Stream captures change of mission into record_persisted (single stream reader)
• Event payload carries identifiers only: mission_id, mission_type, farm_id, case_id, order_id
• ZERO raw objects or personal data in event stream payload" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="600" x="60" y="335" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_dynamo_missions" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#2E27AD;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.dynamodb;" value="Missions" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="590" y="345" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_eb_pipe" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Amazon EventBridge Pipe (ASM-161)
• Reads DynamoDB Stream from missions table
• Filter pattern: { "dynamodb": { "NewImage": { "status": { "S": ["record_persisted"] } } } }
• Target: Custom EventBus drone-service
• Upstream Pipe DLQ: SQS <prefix>-pdn-sqs-pipedlq" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="600" x="60" y="460" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_eb_pipe" parent="1" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;gradientColor=none;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=none;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;pointerEvents=1;shape=mxgraph.aws4.eventbridge_pipes;" value="Pipes" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="590" y="470" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_eb_bus" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Custom EventBridge Bus: drone-service
• Decoupled event distribution for drone mission lifecycle
• Event: mission_record_persisted
• Lets A21 observability and future platform consumers subscribe without touching functions" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="600" x="60" y="570" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_eb_bus" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.eventbridge;" value="EventBus" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="590" y="580" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_eb_rules" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="EventBridge Routing Rules (One Rule Per Mission Type | ASM-161)

1. Rule: rule-inf-confirmation
 • Pattern: { "source": ["aroma.drones"], "detail-type": ["mission_record_persisted"], "detail": { "mission_type": ["confirmation"] } }
 • Target: SQS Confirmation Queue | Retry: 2 attempts, target DLQ

2. Rule: rule-inf-verification
 • Pattern: { "detail": { "mission_type": ["verification"] } }
 • Target: SQS Verification Queue | Retry: 2 attempts, target DLQ

3. Rule: rule-inf-estimation
 • Pattern: { "detail": { "mission_type": ["estimation"] } }
 • Target: SQS Estimation Queue | Retry: 2 attempts, target DLQ" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="600" x="60" y="670" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_telemetry_trigger" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="TRIGGER 4: TELEMETRY BATCH INGESTION (ADR-003, Section 3, Pattern B09 / D09)

Field IoT Nodes (200 Pilot Farms x 2 Nodes | ASM-070)
• Sensors: Crop (soil pH, moisture, temp, NPK) and Drying lot (moisture, grain temp)
• Encrypted ring buffer: stores up to 24 hours of readings during connectivity loss (ASM-074)
• Exit protocol: MQTT over mTLS 1.2+ with unique X.509 client certificate to AWS IoT Core

AWS IoT Core: Regional Ingestion Endpoint (us-east-1 | D09)
• Ingestion Topic: aroma/telemetry/v1/farms/{farm_id}/nodes/{node_id}/readings
• Zero private cloud IPs consumed (identity-based ingestion | ASM-032)
• Peak harvest load: 3,600 readings/day (~0.04/s) scaling to 18,000/day at 1,000 farms

AWS IoT Topic Rule: Dual Parallel Actions (Closes PD-112)
• Action 1 (DynamoDB PutItem):
 - Direct write of reading to DynamoDB telemetry table
 - Primary key: node_id (PK), reading_timestamp (SK)
 - KMS key: telemetry
• Action 2 (SQS SendMessage):
 - Forwards reading key and payload to SQS Threshold Queue
 - Decoupled ingestion; function reads stored reading with strongly consistent GetItem
• Error Action (SQS SendMessage):
 - If Action 1 or 2 fails, payload routed to <prefix>-pdn-sqs-ioterror
 - IoT Rule Error Queue depth monitored by CloudWatch Alarm <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="825" width="600" x="60" y="925" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_iot_core" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#7AA116;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.iot_core;" value="IoT Core" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="590" y="935" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col2_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="SQS QUEUES & FAILURE BUFFERING (Section 6.1)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1605" width="500" x="710" y="165" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_conf" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="1. CONFIRMATION SQS QUEUE
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infconfirm
• Batch size: 1 message (1 mission)
• Visibility timeout: 1,800 s (6x Lambda 300 s timeout)
• KMS Key: records (ASM-097)
• Backoff between attempts: 60 x 2^(n-1) s
 (60 s, 120 s, 240 s, 480 s)
• maxReceiveCount: 5 attempts

Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infconfirmdlq
• Retention: 14 days (maximum SQS retention)
• KMS Key: records
• CloudWatch Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infconfirmdlq
 (ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible > 0)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="265" width="470" x="725" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sqs_conf" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sqs;" value="SQS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="1135" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_ver" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="2. VERIFICATION SQS QUEUE
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infverify
• Batch size: 1 message (1 verification mission)
• Visibility timeout: 1,800 s (6x Lambda timeout)
• KMS Key: records
• Backoff: 60 s, 120 s, 240 s, 480 s
• maxReceiveCount: 5 attempts

Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infverifydlq
• Retention: 14 days | KMS Key: records
• CloudWatch Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infverifydlq
 (MessagesVisible > 0)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="255" width="470" x="725" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sqs_ver" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sqs;" value="SQS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="1135" y="500" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_est" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="3. ESTIMATION SQS QUEUE
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infestimate
• Batch size: 1 message (1 estimation mission)
• Visibility timeout: 1,800 s
• KMS Key: records
• Backoff: 60 s, 120 s, 240 s, 480 s
• maxReceiveCount: 5 attempts

Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infestimatedlq
• Retention: 14 days | KMS Key: records
• CloudWatch Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infestimatedlq
 (MessagesVisible > 0)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="255" width="470" x="725" y="760" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sqs_est" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sqs;" value="SQS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="1135" y="770" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_thresh" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="4. TELEMETRY THRESHOLD QUEUE (D10 / B10 Pattern)
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infthreshold
• Batch size: 10 readings ("lote")
• Batching window: 0 s (evaluates immediately)
• Partial batch failures: ReportBatchItemFailures
• Visibility timeout: 360 s (6x Lambda 60 s timeout)
• KMS Key: records
• Backoff: 10 x 2^(n-1) s (10 s, 20 s, 40 s, 80 s)
 keeps transient retries near the 5-minute alert target
• maxReceiveCount: 5 attempts

Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infthresholddlq
• Retention: 14 days | KMS Key: records
• CloudWatch Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholddlq
 (MessagesVisible > 0)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="315" width="470" x="725" y="1030" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sqs_thresh" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sqs;" value="SQS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="1135" y="1040" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_redrive" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="OPERATOR REDRIVE & UPSTREAM DLQS (Section 6.1)
• Manual SQS DLQ Redrive: Platform operator redrives messages to source queue after root cause resolution.
• Safe Replay: Functions are 100% idempotent (Section 6.3); duplicate redrive finds existing result and exits cleanly without calling Bedrock again.
• Upstream Delivery DLQs:
 - EventBridge Pipe DLQ: captures stream delivery drops
 - EventBridge Rule Target DLQ: captures target queue failures
 - IoT Rule Error Queue: captures failed telemetry store writes
 - Monitored by Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
• 14-day retention: Maximum SQS retention window; CloudWatch alarms on the FIRST message (not on age)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="390" width="470" x="725" y="1360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col3_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#0284c7;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0c4a6e;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="VPC APPLICATION TIER: EVENT-DRIVEN INFERENCE FUNCTIONS (Sections 4 & 11 | D04, D06, D10)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1605" width="980" x="1240" y="165" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vpc_subbanner" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=#0f172a;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=left;spacing=12;" value="VPC: Private Application Subnets across 3 AZs | Interface VPC Endpoints for SQS, S3, DynamoDB, Bedrock, KMS, Logs | D04" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="940" x="1260" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_contract" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#0284c7;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="COMMON 7-STEP FUNCTION CONTRACT (Section 4.1):
1. Receive: take event from SQS (identifiers only: mission_id / reading key; zero PII).
2. Idempotency check: query result by key; if exists, delete message & stop (never calls Bedrock twice).
3. Guard check: verify case/order/mission/node state; if failed, record guard_skipped metric & delete message.
4. Read persisted input: GetObject on S3 (exact version & SHA-256) / consistent GetItem on DynamoDB; verify person_screen == 'clear'.
5. Invoke Bedrock: call Bedrock Converse API on Nova Pro in us-east-1 with versioned prompt & JSON schema.
6. Persist: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: write result record + conditional case/order state transition.
7. Finish: delete SQS message, emit custom CloudWatch metrics, log structured JSON audit line." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="940" x="1260" y="265" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_fn_conf" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="FUNCTION 1: OUTBREAK CONFIRMATION (inf-confirmation | Section 4.2)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5 (bounds parallel Bedrock spend | ASM-162)
• Guard Condition: Pest case in confirming; mission is confirmation mission of this case with record_persisted.
• Reads: S3 bucket photos/ of confirmation mission by version & SHA-256 with person_screen = clear (KMS objects).
• Model Input: Up to 8 focus photos (ASM-168), focus coordinates, alert environmental variables.
• Model Output: pest_signs_present (boolean), signs (text), person_detected (boolean), confidence [0, 1].
• Decision Logic: focus_confirmed if pest_signs_present = true and confidence >= 0.70 (ASM-163); else focus_not_confirmed. If no image usable (all excluded / person detected) -> outcome not_evaluable (reason person_excluded / model_person_detected).
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes confirmation_result under records key in pest case; conditional state transition confirming -> confirmed (allows draft fumigation order) or confirming -> not_confirmed (hands case to agronomist). not_evaluable writes result with NO state transition.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER authorizes, rejects, or creates a fumigation order! Role has NO permission on authorize operation; authorizer_id is strictly writable by human agronomist with MFA only (A09 Section 4.3)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="270" width="940" x="1260" y="405" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_fn_conf" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="inf-confirmation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="2140" y="415" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_fn_ver" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="FUNCTION 2: FUMIGATION VERIFICATION (inf-verification | Section 4.3)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard Condition: Pest case in verifying; fumigation order in executed; mission is verification with record_persisted.
• Reads: S3 bucket photos/ (up to 8 short-pass frames, person_screen = clear) and track/ geometry (verifies pass covered focus; track not sent to Bedrock). KMS objects.
• Model Input: Up to 8 frames, confirmation result of the case for direct comparison.
• Model Output: active_signs_at_focus (boolean), person_detected (boolean), confidence [0, 1].
• Decision Logic: can_close if pass covered focus, active_signs_at_focus = false, and confidence >= 0.70; else cannot_close. If no image usable -> not_evaluable.
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes entry in verification_results of pest case. Conditional transitions: for can_close, case verifying -> closed and order executed -> closed; for cannot_close, case verifying -> verification_not_closable and order executed -> closed. not_evaluable writes result with NO state transition.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER closes case without a persisted verification object, and NEVER changes state when the object did not arrive or invocation failed (case remains in verifying)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="265" width="940" x="1260" y="685" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_fn_ver" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="inf-verification" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="2140" y="695" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_fn_est" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="FUNCTION 3: HARVEST ESTIMATION (inf-estimation | Section 4.4)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard Condition: Farm has active polygon version; mission is estimation mission of review campaign with record_persisted.
• Reads: S3 bucket photos/ (up to 20 plot photos) and maps/ (1 plot map) with person_screen = clear; active farm polygon.
• Model Input: Up to 20 photos and 1 plot map (ASM-168) and prompt describing crop evaluation task.
• Model Output: Per plot: productive_cover_fraction [0, 1], crop_load_class (low, medium, high), person_detected, confidence.
• Decision Logic: Arithmetic formula: estimated_sacks = area_ha x productive_cover_fraction x yield_factor(crop_load_class). Farm estimate is sum over plots with low/high bounds (ASM-166). If yield factors pending published Federation data -> estimate_pending_factors.
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes harvest estimate record for farm and campaign in estimates table; updates Collection Center expected-sacks view.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER creates a packing order, sack, code batch, or sack event! Role has NO permission on sack, trip, or code tables (A16)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="265" width="940" x="1260" y="960" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_fn_est" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="inf-estimation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="2140" y="970" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_fn_thresh" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="FUNCTION 4: TELEMETRY THRESHOLD & PLAUSIBILITY (inf-threshold | Section 4.5 | D10 / B10 Pattern)
• Config: Memory 256 MB | Timeout 60 s | Reserved Concurrency 10 | Batch size 10 (partial failures: ReportBatchItemFailures)
• Guard Condition: Node active in node registry (A14 Section 5, Step 1).
• Reads: Strongly consistent GetItem on DynamoDB telemetry table by key (node_id + reading_timestamp). If item not yet present, retried 3 times (200, 400, 800 ms); if still absent, returned to SQS queue with backoff (Section 6.1). Queries active threshold version from DynamoDB thresholds table at original reading timestamp (zero cache). KMS telemetry and records.
• Rules Evaluation (Federation Configurable Rules): Applied first against dynamic ranges (T-01..T-10). Rules comparison has confidence 1.0 (confidence_basis = rule). Evaluation item written to DynamoDB Alert Store conditional on attribute_not_exists.
• Notification Dispatch (< 5-Minute SLA Budget | Hop 5): Alert event published to Amazon SNS Alert Topic on episode opening, reminder, closure notice, or resolution. Notification dispatch proceeds immediately without waiting for Bedrock.
• Managed Inference (Bedrock Plausibility Check | ASM-167): ONLY invoked for a reading that opens an alert episode, and ONLY AFTER alert message has been published to SNS! Bedrock Nova Pro called with reading, 24h node context, and threshold version. Requests schema: plausibility (field_condition, possible_sensor_fault, indeterminate) + confidence. Plausibility written onto existing evaluation item.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Bedrock NEVER suppresses, delays, or reclassifies an alert, and NEVER changes a pest case! If Bedrock call fails, item records plausibility = unavailable (batch does not fail). Role holds NO write permission on telemetry table." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="515" width="940" x="1260" y="1235" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_fn_thresh" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="inf-threshold" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="2140" y="1245" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col4_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="MANAGED INFERENCE & DATA STORES (Sections 2, 5, 8, 10)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1605" width="730" x="2330" y="165" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_bedrock" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="AMAZON BEDROCK RUNTIME (us-east-1 | ASM-160)

Model: Amazon Nova Pro (amazon.nova-pro-v1:0)
• Vision-capable foundation model offered in-Region in us-east-1
• Invocation mode: On-demand per-request via Bedrock Converse API
• Billing: Billed per input/output token; keeps NO compute waiting
• Zero Training / Zero Custom Model: No fine-tuning, no custom model, no provisioned throughput, no SageMaker real-time endpoints (meets Part E)

Prompting & Output Schema:
• Versioned zero-shot system prompts held as configuration data
• Structured JSON schema requested in Converse API payload
• Confidence score: Uncalibrated self-report in [0, 1]; compared against Federation threshold (0.70 | ASM-163)

Strict Security & Sovereignty Guardrails:
• IAM Role Policy: Allows bedrock:InvokeModel ONLY on:
 arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1::foundation-model/amazon.nova-pro-v1:0
• NO Cross-Region Profiles: Explicitly denied access to any
 arn:aws:bedrock:*::inference-profile/* resource (PD-013)
• Root SCP: Denies all actions requested outside us-east-1
• Zero Model Training: AWS Bedrock terms ensure prompts & outputs are never used to train base foundation models" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="690" x="2350" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_bedrock" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#01A88D;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.bedrock;" value="Nova Pro" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="2980" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_stores" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2E27AD;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="DYNAMODB TRANSACTIONAL STORES ("EXPEDIENTE" | Section 5)

Destination Tables (Encrypted with KMS Key: records | ASM-097):
• cases table: confirmation_result, verification_results
• estimates table: harvest_estimate for farm & campaign
• alerts table (Alert Store): evaluation_item, episode
• telemetry table: strongly consistent read for batch readings
• Retention: 5 years under DynamoDB / S3 Object Lock (ASM-098)

Standardized Result Record Schema (Section 5):
• result_id: Idempotency key ({function}#{mission_id} or reading key)
• function: confirmation | verification | estimation | threshold
• outcome: Decision result or not_evaluable with reason
• result_at: UTC timestamp when persisted ("marca de tiempo")
• confidence & confidence_basis: Score in [0, 1] and model / rule
• source: S3 bucket, key, version, SHA-256 or DynamoDB table, node, timestamp ("identificador del objeto de origen")
• excluded_objects: Key, version, reason for excluded items
• model_id & model_region: amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 and us-east-1
• prompt_version: System prompt & JSON schema version
• bedrock_request_id, input_tokens, output_tokens
• event_id: Triggering event / SQS message identifier

Atomicity & Idempotency:
• DynamoDB TransactWriteItems writes result conditional on attribute_not_exists(result_id) AND case/order state guard" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="450" width="690" x="2350" y="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_stores" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#2E27AD;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.dynamodb;" value="Records" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="2980" y="650" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sns" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="AMAZON SNS: ALERT TOPIC (A14 / ADR-003)
• Topic: <prefix>-pdn-sns-alerts (KMS records)
• Immediate publication on episode opening, reminder, closure notice, or resolution
• Decoupled from Bedrock: Farmer push and SMS notifications dispatched immediately, meeting the < 5-minute SLA budget (Hop 5: 20 s target) without waiting for inference" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="690" x="2350" y="1100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sns" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sns;" value="SNS Alerts" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="2980" y="1110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_s3_privacy" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#e11d48;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="AMAZON S3 DRONE OBJECTS & PERSON PRIVACY (Sections 2 & 10 | PD-015, ASM-164, ASM-165)

S3 Drone Bucket Prefixes (KMS Customer Key: objects):
• farms/{farm_id}/cases/{case_id}/confirmation/photos/
• farms/{farm_id}/cases/{case_id}/verification/photos/ and track/
• farms/{farm_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/estimation/photos/ and maps/
• Object Versioning enabled; SHA-256 verified; NO PutObject/DeleteObject for functions ("el objeto de origen permanece")

Person Privacy Controls (Mandate of Part E):
"Si el objeto contiene una persona, no se envía a inferencia y se documenta el tratamiento del archivo."
1. Detection Before Cloud Upload: Ground-station on-device detector screens photos before upload (ASM-164); manifest marks person_screen = clear or person_present.
2. Platform Fail-Closed: Only clear objects sent to Bedrock; missing/unknown treated as not_screened and excluded.
3. S3 Restricted Storage (ASM-165): Reception function moves person_present objects to:
 restricted/person/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{original_key}
 Encrypted with dedicated KMS customer key: restricted (8th key class).
 S3 Bucket Policy: EXPLICIT DENY on restricted/* for all Lambda inference functions.
4. Cloud Backstop: If Bedrock returns person_detected = true -> result discarded, outcome = not_evaluable (reason model_person_detected), object moved to restricted/, alarm fires." vertex="1"> style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="ERROR OBSERVATION ARCHITECTURE (Section 7, Point 6)

Point 6 Contract:
"Si la invocación falla, el objeto de origen permanece y el estado del caso no cambia. El diseño define reintentos, cola de fallos y dónde se observa el error."

Observation Principles:
• Dual Observation Locus: The observation point is the function's dead-letter queue TOGETHER WITH missions that reached record_persisted without a result (because a message can be lost upstream of the queue).
• Zero False Alarm Tolerance: Alarms trigger immediately on the FIRST dead-letter message (approximate count > 0) due to 14-day retention limits.
• Decoupled Operational Surface: Alarms feed the operational dashboard of A21 without requiring manual polling or inspection of application logs.
• Structured JSON Logging: CloudWatch Logs log groups under KMS logs; structured JSON format recording event_id, mission_id or reading key, outcome, result_id, model request ID, and error class (zero PII, zero images)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="700" x="3120" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_obs_signals" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.cloudwatch_2;" value="Observation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="48" x="3740" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_alarms" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="PROPOSED CLOUDWATCH ALARMS FOR A21 (PC-IAC-003 Physical Naming)

1. Dead-Letter Queue Depth (Messages Visible > 0):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infconfirmdlq: Confirmation DLQ message count > 0
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infverifydlq: Verification DLQ message count > 0
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infestimatedlq: Estimation DLQ message count > 0
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholddlq: Threshold DLQ message count > 0
 Alarm condition: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible > 0 on each queue.

2. Upstream Event Ingestion & Routing Drop:
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
 Monitors EventBridge Pipe DLQ, EventBridge Rule Target DLQs, and FailedInvocations.

3. Oldest Message Age (Queue Processing Lag):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infconfirmage (and infverifyage, infestimateage, infthresholdage)
 Monitors ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage on each function primary queue.

4. Invocations Failed Without State Change (Point 6 Contract):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-inffailed
 Custom metric: InferenceFailed in namespace AromaPacifico/Inference
 Dimensions: function, error_class.

5. Missions Awaiting Result (Pipeline Disconnect):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infawaiting
 Custom metric: MissionsAwaitingResult (missions in record_persisted with no result after age threshold, evaluated via scheduled CloudWatch query).

6. Reading Not Persisted Before Evaluation (Store Coupling):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore
 Custom metric: ReadingNotPersisted & IoT topic rule error queue depth.

7. Bedrock Model Throttling & Quotas:
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthrottle
 Monitors AWS/Bedrock throttles and custom metric InferenceThrottled.

8. Person Detected in Crop Object (CRITICAL Privacy Incident):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infperson
 Custom metric: ModelPersonDetected > 0 (triggers immediate operator incident response)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1090" width="700" x="3120" y="480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_sovereignty" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="DATA SOVEREIGNTY: WHAT LEAVES COLOMBIA (Section 8.2 | PD-013, ASM-002)

No AWS Region exists in Colombia (ADR-001). Every cloud object and record is stored in us-east-1 (N. Virginia, USA) under ASM-002.
The table separates what is only stored in us-east-1 from what is also sent to Bedrock in us-east-1 (Section 8.2):

+--------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------+
| Object or Record | Stored in us-east-1 | Sent to Bedrock in us-east-1 |
+--------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------+
| Confirmation photos with person_screen = clear | YES (S3 objects) | YES (up to 8 focus photos) |
| Verification photos & short-pass frames (clear) | YES (S3 objects) | YES (up to 8 frames) |
| Estimation photos & plot maps (clear) | YES (S3 objects) | YES (up to 20 photos + 1 map)|
| Telemetry reading opening an episode + 24h node readings | YES (DynamoDB) | YES (opening reading + ctx) |
| Other telemetry readings (routine 6/day or 24/day) | YES (DynamoDB) | NO (rules evaluated locally) |
| Flight records, tracks, polygons, mission packages | YES (S3 / Dynamo) | NO (track verified in Lambda)|
| Delimitation objects (area flight mode) | YES (S3 objects) | NO (no function runs on it) |
| Objects with person_present or not_screened | YES (restricted/) | NO (strictly excluded) |
| Personal data (names, cédula, phone, plate, credentials) | YES (personal-data)| NO (functions hold no key) |
+--------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------+

Legal & Compliance Safeguards:
• Transfer of Colombian agricultural data to USA is submitted to the Federation under Question Q-02 and PD-101.
• Personal Data Isolation: Stored in personal-data table encrypted with KMS personal; no inference function role holds this key.
• Bedrock Terms: Amazon Bedrock does not use customer prompts or completions to train base foundation models." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="600" width="1180" x="40" y="1790" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_matrix" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="FAILURE HANDLING MATRIX & STATE INVARIANCE (Sections 6.1 - 6.4)

Mandate of Part E: "Si la invocación falla, el objeto de origen permanece y el estado del caso no cambia."

+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Failure Scenario | Source Object or Record | Case / Order / Alert State | Where It Is Observed |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Bedrock throttles or errors on all attempts | UNCHANGED in S3 / DynamoDB | UNCHANGED: no result written, no | Function DLQ depth > 0; |
| (Adaptive SDK retry exhausted, 3 attempts) | (Functions have no write/delete) | state transition. Case confirming. | Alarm <prefix>-pdn-alarm-inffailed |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Function crashes or times out after model | UNCHANGED in S3 / DynamoDB | UNCHANGED: DynamoDB transaction | Lambda Errors metric; SQS queue |
| answered (e.g. at 300 s timeout) | | did not commit. Next retry calls. | receiveCount increments. |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| DynamoDB transaction condition fails | UNCHANGED in S3 | UNCHANGED: result not written. | Metric guard_skipped with reason |
| (State moved, e.g. agronomist closed case) | | Case remains in its new state. | state_changed. SQS message deleted.|
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Telemetry store write fails (IoT Rule) | NOT in table; payload buffered | UNCHANGED: evaluation message | IoT error queue depth; Alarm |
| | in IoT Rule Error SQS Queue | retries with backoff; no false alert| <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore|
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Plausibility Bedrock call fails | UNCHANGED in DynamoDB | Alert ALREADY published to farmer; | Metric PlausibilityUnavailable; |
| (Telemetry episode opening) | | item marked plausibility=unavailable| Batch does NOT fail. |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+

Idempotency Mechanics (Section 6.3):
• Drone Functions: result_id = {function}#{mission_id}. Conditional put prevents duplicate result; transaction verifies source state.
• Telemetry Function: result_id = {node_id}#{variable}#{reading_timestamp}. Conditional put prevents duplicate episode opening.
• SQS Dead-Letter Redrive: Safe to redrive at any time; duplicate event finds existing result and deletes itself without calling model." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="600" width="1380" x="1240" y="1790" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_citations" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="IaC TRACEABILITY, HARVEST VOLUMES & CITATIONS (Sections 9, 11, 13, 14)

Track B / IaC Box Traceability (docs/architecture.md Section 14):
• D10 (Track B Issue #30 / B10): The Event-Driven Inference Function Pattern
 Coded pattern of Epic 6: SQS threshold queue, Lambda rules engine, Alert Store, SNS topic, Bedrock plausibility check, DLQs.
• D09 (Track B Issue #29 / B09): Telemetry Ingestion Pattern Module (ADR-003)
 AWS IoT Core, topic rules, DynamoDB telemetry table, IoT rule error SQS queue.
• D06 (Track B Issue #26 / B06): Identities & KMS Customer Keys
 IAM Lambda execution roles (least privilege), KMS keys: records, telemetry, objects, logs, restricted.
• D04 (Track B Issue #24 / B04): VPC & Application Tier
 Private subnets across 3 AZs, VPC interface endpoints for SQS, Bedrock, S3, DynamoDB, KMS, CloudWatch.

Harvest Volume & Spend Drivers (Section 9 | ASM-168, ASM-169):
• Telemetry: 108,000 readings/harvest month (200 farms x 6/day + 100 farms x 24/day). Model called ONLY on episode openings (E calls).
• Confirmation: N_conf missions (~1/alert); up to 8 focus photos.
• Verification: N_ver missions (~1/fumigation); up to 8 short-pass frames.
• Estimation: 200 flights/month (1/farm/harvest campaign); up to 20 plot photos + 1 plot map.
• Cost Optimization: On-demand Bedrock (zero idle compute), idempotency avoids re-invocation, image caps enforce predictable token budgets.

• PD-112 (Closed: Telemetry store coupling) • PD-135 (Closed: A14 evaluation contract)

Amazon DynamoDB: missions Table & DynamoDB Streams (ASM-149)
• Reception function writes record_persisted in a single atomic transaction
• Stream captures change of mission into record_persisted (single stream reader)
• Event payload carries identifiers only: mission_id, mission_type, farm_id, case_id, order_id
• ZERO raw objects or personal data in event stream payload

div.div:
TRIGGER 4: TELEMETRY BATCH INGESTION (ADR-003, Section 3, Pattern B09 / D09)
Field IoT Nodes (200 Pilot Farms x 2 Nodes | ASM-070)
• Sensors: Crop (soil pH, moisture, temp, NPK) and Drying lot (moisture, grain temp)
• Encrypted ring buffer: stores up to 24 hours of readings during connectivity loss (ASM-074)
• Exit protocol: MQTT over mTLS 1.2+ with unique X.509 client certificate to AWS IoT Core
AWS IoT Core: Regional Ingestion Endpoint (us-east-1 | D09)
• Ingestion Topic: aroma/telemetry/v1/farms/{farm_id}/nodes/{node_id}/readings
• Zero private cloud IPs consumed (identity-based ingestion | ASM-032)
• Peak harvest load: 3,600 readings/day (~0.04/s) scaling to 18,000/day at 1,000 farms
AWS IoT Topic Rule: Dual Parallel Actions (Closes PD-112)
• Action 1 (DynamoDB PutItem):
- Direct write of reading to DynamoDB telemetry table
- Primary key: node_id (PK), reading_timestamp (SK)
- KMS key: telemetry
• Action 2 (SQS SendMessage):
- Forwards reading key and payload to SQS Threshold Queue
- Decoupled ingestion; function reads stored reading with strongly consistent GetItem
• Error Action (SQS SendMessage):
- If Action 1 or 2 fails, payload routed to -pdn-sqs-ioterror
- IoT Rule Error Queue depth monitored by CloudWatch Alarm -pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore

OPERATOR REDRIVE & UPSTREAM DLQS (Section 6.1)
• Manual SQS DLQ Redrive: Platform operator redrives messages to source queue after root cause resolution.
• Safe Replay: Functions are 100% idempotent (Section 6.3); duplicate redrive finds existing result and exits cleanly without calling Bedrock again.
• Upstream Delivery DLQs:
- EventBridge Pipe DLQ: captures stream delivery drops
- EventBridge Rule Target DLQ: captures target queue failures
- IoT Rule Error Queue: captures failed telemetry store writes
- Monitored by Alarm: -pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
• 14-day retention: Maximum SQS retention window; CloudWatch alarms on the FIRST message (not on age).

div.div:
COMMON 7-STEP FUNCTION CONTRACT (Section 4.1):
1. Receive: take event from SQS (identifiers only: mission_id / reading key; zero PII).
2. Idempotency check: query result by key; if exists, delete message & stop (never calls Bedrock twice).
3. Guard check: verify case/order/mission/node state; if failed, record guard_skipped metric & delete message.
4. Read persisted input: GetObject on S3 (exact version & SHA-256) / consistent GetItem on DynamoDB; verify person_screen == 'clear'.
5. Invoke Bedrock: call Bedrock Converse API on Nova Pro in us-east-1 with versioned prompt & JSON schema.
6. Persist: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: write result record + conditional case/order state transition.
7. Finish: delete SQS message, emit custom CloudWatch metrics, log structured JSON audit line.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 922px; height: 1px; padding-top: 405px; margin-left: 1241px;

div.div:
FUNCTION 1: OUTBREAK CONFIRMATION (inf-confirmation | Section 4.2)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5 (bounds parallel Bedrock spend | ASM-162)
• Guard Condition: Pest case in confirming; mission is confirmation mission of this case with record_persisted.
• Reads: S3 bucket photos/ of confirmation mission by version & SHA-256 with person_screen = clear (KMS objects).
• Model Input: Up to 8 focus photos (ASM-168), focus coordinates, alert environmental variables.
• Model Output: pest_signs_present (boolean), signs (text), person_detected (boolean), confidence [0, 1].
• Decision Logic: focus_confirmed if pest_signs_present = true and confidence >= 0.70 (ASM-163); else focus_not_confirmed. If no image usable (all excluded / person detected) -> outcome not_evaluable (reason person_excluded / model_person_detected).
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes confirmation_result under records key in pest case; conditional state transition confirming -> confirmed (allows draft fumigation order) or confirming -> not_confirmed (hands case to agronomist). not_evaluable writes result with NO state transition.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER authorizes, rejects, or creates a fumigation order! Role has NO permission on authorize operation; authorizer_id is strictly writable by human agronomist with MFA only (A09 Section 4.3).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 455px; margin-left: 2135px;

display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 922px; height: 1px; padding-top: 685px; margin-left: 1241px;

div.div:
FUNCTION 2: FUMIGATION VERIFICATION (inf-verification | Section 4.3)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard Condition: Pest case in verifying; fumigation order in executed; mission is verification with record_persisted.
• Reads: S3 bucket photos/ (up to 8 short-pass frames, person_screen = clear) and track/ geometry (verifies pass covered focus; track not sent to Bedrock). KMS objects.
• Model Input: Up to 8 frames, confirmation result of the case for direct comparison.
• Model Output: active_signs_at_focus (boolean), person_detected (boolean), confidence [0, 1].
• Decision Logic: can_close if pass covered focus, active_signs_at_focus = false, and confidence >= 0.70; else cannot_close. If no image usable -> not_evaluable.
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes entry in verification_results of pest case. Conditional transitions: for can_close, case verifying -> closed and order executed -> closed; for cannot_close, case verifying -> verification_not_closable and order executed -> closed. not_evaluable writes result with NO state transition.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER closes case without a persisted verification object, and NEVER changes state when the object did not arrive or invocation failed (case remains in verifying).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 735px; margin-left: 2135px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #232F3E;

display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 922px; height: 1px; padding-top: 960px; margin-left: 1241px;

div.div:
FUNCTION 3: HARVEST ESTIMATION (inf-estimation | Section 4.4)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard Condition: Farm has active polygon version; mission is estimation mission of review campaign with record_persisted.
• Reads: S3 bucket photos/ (up to 20 plot photos) and maps/ (1 plot map) with person_screen = clear; active farm polygon.
• Model Input: Up to 20 photos and 1 plot map (ASM-168) and prompt describing crop evaluation task.
• Model Output: Per plot: productive_cover_fraction [0, 1], crop_load_class (low, medium, high), person_detected, confidence.
• Decision Logic: Arithmetic formula: estimated_sacks = area_ha x productive_cover_fraction x yield_factor(crop_load_class). Farm estimate is sum over plots with low/high bounds (ASM-166). If yield factors pending published Federation data -> estimate_pending_factors.
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes harvest estimate record for farm and campaign in estimates table; updates Collection Center expected-sacks view.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER creates a packing order, sack, code batch, or sack event! Role has NO permission on sack, trip, or code tables (A16).

div.div:
FUNCTION 4: TELEMETRY THRESHOLD & PLAUSIBILITY (inf-threshold | Section 4.5 | D10 / B10 Pattern)
• Config: Memory 256 MB | Timeout 60 s | Reserved Concurrency 10 | Batch size 10 (partial failures: ReportBatchItemFailures)
• Guard Condition: Node active in node registry (A14 Section 5, Step 1).
• Reads: Strongly consistent GetItem on DynamoDB telemetry table by key (node_id + reading_timestamp). If item not yet present, retried 3 times (200, 400, 800 ms); if still absent, returned to SQS queue with backoff (Section 6.1). Queries active threshold version from DynamoDB thresholds table at original reading timestamp (zero cache). KMS telemetry and records.
• Rules Evaluation (Federation Configurable Rules): Applied first against dynamic ranges (T-01..T-10). Rules comparison has confidence 1.0 (confidence_basis = rule). Evaluation item written to DynamoDB Alert Store conditional on attribute_not_exists.
• Notification Dispatch (< 5-Minute SLA Budget | Hop 5): Alert event published to Amazon SNS Alert Topic on episode opening, reminder, closure notice, or resolution. Notification dispatch proceeds immediately without waiting for Bedrock.
• Managed Inference (Bedrock Plausibility Check | ASM-167): ONLY invoked for a reading that opens an alert episode, and ONLY AFTER alert message has been published to SNS! Bedrock Nova Pro called with reading, 24h node context, and threshold version. Requests schema: plausibility (field_condition, possible_sensor_fault, indeterminate) + confidence. Plausibility written onto existing evaluation item.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Bedrock NEVER suppresses, delays, or reclassifies an alert, and NEVER changes a pest case! If Bedrock call fails, item records plausibility = unavailable (batch does not fail). Role holds NO write permission on telemetry table.

div.div:
AMAZON BEDROCK RUNTIME (us-east-1 | ASM-160)
Model: Amazon Nova Pro (amazon.nova-pro-v1:0)
• Vision-capable foundation model offered in-Region in us-east-1
• Invocation mode: On-demand per-request via Bedrock Converse API
• Billing: Billed per input/output token; keeps NO compute waiting
• Zero Training / Zero Custom Model: No fine-tuning, no custom model, no provisioned throughput, no SageMaker real-time endpoints (meets Part E)
Prompting & Output Schema:
• Versioned zero-shot system prompts held as configuration data
• Structured JSON schema requested in Converse API payload
• Confidence score: Uncalibrated self-report in [0, 1]; compared against Federation threshold (0.70 | ASM-163)
Strict Security & Sovereignty Guardrails:
• IAM Role Policy: Allows bedrock:InvokeModel ONLY on:
arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1::foundation-model/amazon.nova-pro-v1:0
• NO Cross-Region Profiles: Explicitly denied access to any
arn:aws:bedrock:*::inference-profile/* resource (PD-013)
• Root SCP: Denies all actions requested outside us-east-1
• Zero Model Training: AWS Bedrock terms ensure prompts & outputs are never used to train base foundation models

div.div:
DYNAMODB TRANSACTIONAL STORES ("EXPEDIENTE" | Section 5)
Destination Tables (Encrypted with KMS Key: records | ASM-097):
• cases table: confirmation_result, verification_results
• estimates table: harvest_estimate for farm & campaign
• alerts table (Alert Store): evaluation_item, episode
• telemetry table: strongly consistent read for batch readings
• Retention: 5 years under DynamoDB / S3 Object Lock (ASM-098)
Standardized Result Record Schema (Section 5):
• result_id: Idempotency key ({function}#{mission_id} or reading key)
• function: confirmation | verification | estimation | threshold
• outcome: Decision result or not_evaluable with reason
• result_at: UTC timestamp when persisted ("marca de tiempo")
• confidence & confidence_basis: Score in [0, 1] and model / rule
• source: S3 bucket, key, version, SHA-256 or DynamoDB table, node, timestamp ("identificador del objeto de origen")
• excluded_objects: Key, version, reason for excluded items
• model_id & model_region: amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 and us-east-1
• prompt_version: System prompt & JSON schema version
• bedrock_request_id, input_tokens, output_tokens
• event_id: Triggering event / SQS message identifier
Atomicity & Idempotency:
• DynamoDB TransactWriteItems writes result conditional on attribute_not_exists(result_id) AND case/order state guard

div.div:
AMAZON SNS: ALERT TOPIC (A14 / ADR-003)
• Topic: -pdn-sns-alerts (KMS records)
• Immediate publication on episode opening, reminder, closure notice, or resolution
• Decoupled from Bedrock: Farmer push and SMS notifications dispatched immediately, meeting the < 5-minute SLA budget (Hop 5: 20 s target) without waiting for inference

div.div:
AMAZON S3 DRONE OBJECTS & PERSON PRIVACY (Sections 2 & 10 | PD-015, ASM-164, ASM-165)
S3 Drone Bucket Prefixes (KMS Customer Key: objects):
• farms/{farm_id}/cases/{case_id}/confirmation/photos/
• farms/{farm_id}/cases/{case_id}/verification/photos/ and track/
• farms/{farm_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/estimation/photos/ and maps/
• Object Versioning enabled; SHA-256 verified; NO PutObject/DeleteObject for functions ("el objeto de origen permanece")
Person Privacy Controls (Mandate of Part E):
"Si el objeto contiene una persona, no se envía a inferencia y se documenta el tratamiento del archivo."
1. Detection Before Cloud Upload: Ground-station on-device detector screens photos before upload (ASM-164); manifest marks person_screen = clear or person_present.
2. Platform Fail-Closed: Only clear objects sent to Bedrock; missing/unknown treated as not_screened and excluded.
3. S3 Restricted Storage (ASM-165): Reception function moves person_present objects to:
restricted/person/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{original_key}
Encrypted with dedicated KMS customer key: restricted (8th key class).
S3 Bucket Policy: EXPLICIT DENY on restricted/* for all Lambda inference functions.
4. Cloud Backstop: If Bedrock returns person_detected = true -> result discarded, outcome = not_evaluable (reason model_person_detected), object moved to restricted/, alarm fires.

div.div:
ERROR OBSERVATION ARCHITECTURE (Section 7, Point 6)
Point 6 Contract:
"Si la invocación falla, el objeto de origen permanece y el estado del caso no cambia. El diseño define reintentos, cola de fallos y dónde se observa el error."
Observation Principles:
• Dual Observation Locus: The observation point is the function's dead-letter queue TOGETHER WITH missions that reached record_persisted without a result (because a message can be lost upstream of the queue).
• Zero False Alarm Tolerance: Alarms trigger immediately on the FIRST dead-letter message (approximate count > 0) due to 14-day retention limits.
• Decoupled Operational Surface: Alarms feed the operational dashboard of A21 without requiring manual polling or inspection of application logs.
• Structured JSON Logging: CloudWatch Logs log groups under KMS logs; structured JSON format recording event_id, mission_id or reading key, outcome, result_id, model request ID, and error class (zero PII, zero images).

div.div:
PROPOSED CLOUDWATCH ALARMS FOR A21 (PC-IAC-003 Physical Naming)
1. Dead-Letter Queue Depth (Messages Visible > 0):
• -pdn-alarm-infconfirmdlq: Confirmation DLQ message count > 0
• -pdn-alarm-infverifydlq: Verification DLQ message count > 0
• -pdn-alarm-infestimatedlq: Estimation DLQ message count > 0
• -pdn-alarm-infthresholddlq: Threshold DLQ message count > 0
Alarm condition: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible > 0 on each queue.
2. Upstream Event Ingestion & Routing Drop:
• -pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
Monitors EventBridge Pipe DLQ, EventBridge Rule Target DLQs, and FailedInvocations.
3. Oldest Message Age (Queue Processing Lag):
• -pdn-alarm-infconfirmage (and infverifyage, infestimateage, infthresholdage)
Monitors ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage on each function primary queue.
4. Invocations Failed Without State Change (Point 6 Contract):
• -pdn-alarm-inffailed
Custom metric: InferenceFailed in namespace AromaPacifico/Inference
Dimensions: function, error_class.
5. Missions Awaiting Result (Pipeline Disconnect):
• -pdn-alarm-infawaiting
Custom metric: MissionsAwaitingResult (missions in record_persisted with no result after age threshold, evaluated via scheduled CloudWatch query).
6. Reading Not Persisted Before Evaluation (Store Coupling):
• -pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore
Custom metric: ReadingNotPersisted & IoT topic rule error queue depth.
7. Bedrock Model Throttling & Quotas:
• -pdn-alarm-infthrottle
Monitors AWS/Bedrock throttles and custom metric InferenceThrottled.
8. Person Detected in Crop Object (CRITICAL Privacy Incident):
• -pdn-alarm-infperson
Custom metric: ModelPersonDetected > 0 (triggers immediate operator incident response).

div.div:
DATA SOVEREIGNTY: WHAT LEAVES COLOMBIA (Section 8.2 | PD-013, ASM-002)
No AWS Region exists in Colombia (ADR-001). Every cloud object and record is stored in us-east-1 (N. Virginia, USA) under ASM-002.
The table separates what is only stored in us-east-1 from what is also sent to Bedrock in us-east-1 (Section 8.2):
+--------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------+
| Object or Record | Stored in us-east-1 | Sent to Bedrock in us-east-1 |
+--------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------+
| Confirmation photos with person_screen = clear | YES (S3 objects) | YES (up to 8 focus photos) |
| Verification photos & short-pass frames (clear) | YES (S3 objects) | YES (up to 8 frames) |
| Estimation photos & plot maps (clear) | YES (S3 objects) | YES (up to 20 photos + 1 map)|
| Telemetry reading opening an episode + 24h node readings | YES (DynamoDB) | YES (opening reading + ctx) |
| Other telemetry readings (routine 6/day or 24/day) | YES (DynamoDB) | NO (rules evaluated locally) |
| Flight records, tracks, polygons, mission packages | YES (S3 / Dynamo) | NO (track verified in Lambda)|
| Delimitation objects (area flight mode) | YES (S3 objects) | NO (no function runs on it) |
| Objects with person_present or not_screened | YES (restricted/) | NO (strictly excluded) |
| Personal data (names, cédula, phone, plate, credentials) | YES (personal-data)| NO (functions hold no key) |
+--------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+------------------------------+
Legal & Compliance Safeguards:
• Transfer of Colombian agricultural data to USA is submitted to the Federation under Question Q-02 and PD-101.
• Personal Data Isolation: Stored in personal-data table encrypted with KMS personal; no inference function role holds this key.
• Bedrock Terms: Amazon Bedrock does not use customer prompts or completions to train base foundation models.

div.div:
FAILURE HANDLING MATRIX & STATE INVARIANCE (Sections 6.1 - 6.4)
Mandate of Part E: "Si la invocación falla, el objeto de origen permanece y el estado del caso no cambia."
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Failure Scenario | Source Object or Record | Case / Order / Alert State | Where It Is Observed |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Bedrock throttles or errors on all attempts | UNCHANGED in S3 / DynamoDB | UNCHANGED: no result written, no | Function DLQ depth > 0; |
| (Adaptive SDK retry exhausted, 3 attempts) | (Functions have no write/delete) | state transition. Case confirming. | Alarm -pdn-alarm-inffailed |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Function crashes or times out after model | UNCHANGED in S3 / DynamoDB | UNCHANGED: DynamoDB transaction | Lambda Errors metric; SQS queue |
| answered (e.g. at 300 s timeout) | | did not commit. Next retry calls. | receiveCount increments. |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| DynamoDB transaction condition fails | UNCHANGED in S3 | UNCHANGED: result not written. | Metric guard_skipped with reason |
| (State moved, e.g. agronomist closed case) | | Case remains in its new state. | state_changed. SQS message deleted.|
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Telemetry store write fails (IoT Rule) | NOT in table; payload buffered | UNCHANGED: evaluation message | IoT error queue depth; Alarm |
| | in IoT Rule Error SQS Queue | retries with backoff; no false alert| -pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore|
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Plausibility Bedrock call fails | UNCHANGED in DynamoDB | Alert ALREADY published to farmer; | Metric PlausibilityUnavailable; |
| (Telemetry episode opening) | | item marked plausibility=unavailable| Batch does NOT fail. |
+---------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
Idempotency Mechanics (Section 6.3):
• Drone Functions: result_id = {function}#{mission_id}. Conditional put prevents duplicate result; transaction verifies source state.
• Telemetry Function: result_id = {node_id}#{variable}#{reading_timestamp}. Conditional put prevents duplicate episode opening.
• SQS Dead-Letter Redrive: Safe to redrive at any time; duplicate event finds existing result and deletes itself without calling model.

div.div:
IaC TRACEABILITY, HARVEST VOLUMES & CITATIONS (Sections 9, 11, 13, 14)
Track B / IaC Box Traceability (docs/architecture.md Section 14):
• D10 (Track B Issue #30 / B10): The Event-Driven Inference Function Pattern
Coded pattern of Epic 6: SQS threshold queue, Lambda rules engine, Alert Store, SNS topic, Bedrock plausibility check, DLQs.
• D09 (Track B Issue #29 / B09): Telemetry Ingestion Pattern Module (ADR-003)
AWS IoT Core, topic rules, DynamoDB telemetry table, IoT rule error SQS queue.
• D06 (Track B Issue #26 / B06): Identities & KMS Customer Keys
IAM Lambda execution roles (least privilege), KMS keys: records, telemetry, objects, logs, restricted.
• D04 (Track B Issue #24 / B04): VPC & Application Tier
Private subnets across 3 AZs, VPC interface endpoints for SQS, Bedrock, S3, DynamoDB, KMS, CloudWatch.
Harvest Volume & Spend Drivers (Section 9 | ASM-168, ASM-169):
• Telemetry: 108,000 readings/harvest month (200 farms x 6/day + 100 farms x 24/day). Model called ONLY on episode openings (E calls).
• Confirmation: N_conf missions (~1/alert); up to 8 focus photos.
• Verification: N_ver missions (~1/fumigation); up to 8 short-pass frames.
• Estimation: 200 flights/month (1/farm/harvest campaign); up to 20 plot photos + 1 plot map.
• Cost Optimization: On-demand Bedrock (zero idle compute), idempotency avoids re-invocation, image caps enforce predictable token budgets.
Normative Decision-Log Citations (docs/decision-log.md):
• ASM-160 (Bedrock Nova Pro in us-east-1) • ASM-161 (Delivery paths & SQS decoupling)
• ASM-162 (Failure parameters & backoff) • ASM-163 (0.70 confidence threshold)
• ASM-164 (On-device person detector) • ASM-165 (Restricted prefix & key)
• ASM-166 (Estimation formula & factors) • ASM-167 (Telemetry plausibility on openings)
• ASM-168 (Image caps per invocation) • ASM-169 (Named pricing parameters for A23)
• PD-013 (Closed: Region & Colombia exit) • PD-014 (Closed: Retries, DLQ & observation)
• PD-015 (Closed: Person object handling) • PD-111 (Closed: Persisted object trigger)
• PD-112 (Closed: Telemetry store coupling) • PD-135 (Closed: A14 evaluation contract)
• PD-161 (Closed: B10 telemetry pattern) • PD-018 (Open: AWS live feature re-check)
